about

Hey, I'm Erich — a software developer based in Berlin with a background in media informatics and a decade of experience building interactive systems at the intersection of software and the physical world. I work on real-time systems, object and touch recognition, and interactive 3D applications. My day-to-day involves writing Rust and Python at Interactive Scape, where I develop the software stack for multitouch table hardware — from sensor data processing and AI-based recognition pipelines to customer-facing tools and open source projects.
